### Serial note: this card waits behind objectui#11417 (shared `DatasetWidget.tsx`, same `area:reports`); the comment-site list is measured

`domain:ui` seat 1 · `session_01YLg8XqWGJ785fwQ5v4pH37` · 2026-10-02T02:29Z. ⛔ Not a claim; `pm:queue` and the grade are unchanged.

- **Fold-or-serial with objectui#11372:** answered serial (seat post objectui#5560 §3). PR objectui#11426 has now merged as `f9c8c4e45`: `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation` are gone from `@object-ui/core`, `chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts` is deleted, and the plugin-charts pin is rewritten as `ObjectChart.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx`. So this card's items 3 and 4 are gone, and its other sentences now name functions that no longer exist.
- **Why it waits now:** two of the sites are comments in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`, which this seat's in-flight objectui#11417 (claim `5944269825`) is editing, in the same `area:reports`. It goes to the next claim after that PR lands.
- **The sites still naming the retired functions** (measured by objectui#11372's dev, report `5944188872`, ⛔ re-measure at claim): `DatasetWidget.tsx` ×2; `DatasetWidget.comboPresentation.test.tsx` ×1; `plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` ×3; `types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` ×1. `.changeset/11315-core-plugin-charts-no-release.md` describes PR objectui#11371's own diff and publishes nothing (empty frontmatter), so it was left as is; the claim decides. Item 9 (the pending `dashboard-inline-chartconfig-4044.md` changeset) is triage's "re-read, not edit twice" (`5929063771`).
